name: static-seed
description: Portable modular House of Houses: independent homes, rooms, attachable workbenches, source-aware business partnerships/fiction/publishing and owner-gated handoffs. Skills and optional local registry; no hosted collaboration.

interface.longDescription: Grow independent homes for business, partnerships, story worlds, books and projects. Build bounded rooms, attach relevant workbenches (including Neighbor Weave) and carry consent-aware return cards. Portable methods, not a hosted shared service.
defaultPrompt: Help me use STATIC SEED on the most important thing I am working on.
Map my cleaning-business workflow, locate a bottleneck, and propose one useful improvement.
Help me build my story world, test its continuity, and plan one publication.
Find mutual local business partnership opportunities using Neighbor Weave; keep introductions and relationships unclaimed until confirmed.
